# Rats Collective

> TikTok music marketing for record labels, artists and marketing agencies.

Rats Collective operates a network of 20+ active TikTok accounts. Account identities and network details are available on request. Campaigns focus on U.S. and U.K. audiences. Business inquiries are welcome in English and Finnish.

## Current services
- [TikTok music campaigns](https://ratscollective.com/contact/#tiktok-campaigns): Campaign planning, page sourcing and delivery for labels, artists and agencies. One-off or ongoing campaigns can combine our network with external TikTok pages. Reporting covers performance, cost per thousand views (CPM) and conversion metrics where measurable.
- [Sound promotion & page placements](https://ratscollective.com/contact/#page-placements): Promote music through our network of 20+ active TikTok accounts, as standalone placements or part of a wider campaign. Account details are available on request.
- [Artist fan-page services](https://ratscollective.com/contact/#fan-pages): Monthly TikTok fan-page management for artists, labels and agencies. Posting volume, content direction, aesthetics and community interaction are agreed for each project.
- [Creator & influencer management](https://ratscollective.com/contact/#creator-management): Music campaign opportunities, deal sourcing and rate negotiation for TikTok creators and influencers, on a commission basis.
- [UGC & brand campaigns](https://ratscollective.com/contact/#ugc-brand-campaigns): TikTok creator-content campaigns for brand awareness and brand messaging, available on request. Content briefs and deliverables are agreed per campaign.

## Artist management inquiries
Rats Collective is exploring artist partnerships built around music promotion. Artist management is a potential partnership area, not an established roster or guaranteed offer. Artists can send music, social links and their goals to start a conversation.
